description: Main activity for Android shortcut sample; manages shortcuts, UI interactions, and intent handling.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: Main activity class extending ListActivity that manages app shortcuts and UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up shortcuts, handles incoming intent actions, and sets the adapter.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Refreshes the shortcut list and updates UI elements.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Removes activity instance from the visible instances set.

methods.name: onAddPressed
methods.description: Handles user pressing add shortcut button.

methods.name: onRequestNewPinPressed
methods.description: Handles request pin shortcut button press.

methods.name: addWebSite
methods.description: Prompts the user to input a website URL and adds a shortcut.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Updates the list adapter with current shortcuts.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks within shortcut list item views.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Generates a string describing the shortcut's attributes.
